svg.title: Security model
svg.desc: - keepSignedIn runs in the background. A launch agent sends each site you mark a request with your cookies every 10 minutes, so its session never idles out, and keeps the site's session-only cookies on disk as keepSession does. The agent is a per-user LaunchAgent: it runs as you, only while you're logged in, and needs no admin rights. Choosing Keep Signed In again in the site's … menu, or umbra keep-signed-in <site> --off, removes it once no site is marked. To remove it by hand, launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.randyren.umbra.keep-signed-in and delete ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.randyren.umbra.keep-signed-in.plist (a profile's label ends in .<profile>).

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
